title: IB protective re-assert reverts a just-applied trail amend from a stale row read: _check_broker_naked_ib_positions (reconciliation-loop thread) grades and re-asserts against row['stop_loss'] from the row set it read at sweep start, so a trail amend that lands mid-sweep is cancelled and the PREVIOUS stop re-placed. Measured on ib_paper MGC trade 7737 (pkg-8958fc7d4ee74c60), paper. Fix: re-read trades.stop_loss/take_profit_1 fresh immediately before _reassert_from_divergence decides (and re-grade against that), or skip the re-assert when the trade/package was updated within the last sweep interval; then the 1 h cooldown cannot lock the wrong level in.
